slots.name: lead
slots.about: the bold paragraph on top: what to write and why it helps

slots.name: min_chars
slots.about: the least the message needs (spaces at the ends don't count)

slots.name: max_chars
slots.about: the most the message may hold

slots.name: count_line
slots.about: the count under the field's end; may read used and max_chars

slots.name: short_text
slots.about: the field's error after a send that was too short; may read need (characters still missing)

slots.name: over_text
slots.about: the field's error while over the limit, shown at once; may read over_by

slots.name: optional_word
slots.about: the quiet word after the question that says the topic is not needed

slots.name: topics
slots.about: the topics: id (1 up), name; 0 or more, with none the question is left out

slots.name: note
slots.about: the fine print under the button: what not to put in a report

slots.name: sent_line
slots.about: the line under it; may read sent_count and last_topic (the topic name sent, or "")

slots.name: set_text
slots.about: {event}: the field sends its whole text as it changes

slots.name: pick_topic
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: picks one topic, a second tap on it clears the pick

slots.name: send
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: sends when long enough and under the limit; otherwise marks the try so the short error shows

slots.name: again
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: from the sent state back to an empty form

empty.shows: no topic question; the message alone is the form

attention.shows: over the limit: the count turns destructive and the field says by how much, at once; too short: the field says how much is missing, only after a send

fallback.shows: sent_box in place of the form, naming the topic sent; again brings back an empty form

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops swap, snappy, shrink and rise
accessibility.not_colour_alone: over the limit and too short are said in words on the field; the picked topic is a dot in the ring, not only a colour; optional is a word
